review_evidence: SphericalCompleteness/Basic.lean, Dense.lean, and NormedVectorSpace/SphericalCompletion/* formalize spherical completeness and completion constructions.
NormedVectorSpace/ContinuousLinearMap/Extension.lean and HahnBanach.lean plus Orthogonal/* contain substantive reusable analysis results.

DependencyExtractor.lean defines getRelevantConstsFromConst, BFSState, Source, graph traversal, serialization, and file-writing helpers; these are unique declarations rather than a declaration-free generated artifact.
summary: Reviewed the complete SphericalCompleteness unit. The primary tree is substantive nonarchimedean functional analysis, and its DependencyExtractor.lean contains unique Lean metaprogramming declarations, so it is retained under the content-level losslessness rule.
